rows.Common Pathogens: Polymicrobial (staph, strep spp., enterobacteriaceae, pseudomonas) anaerobes
rows.Empirical AMA: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 1.2g IV q8h OR Ampicillin sulbactam 3g IV q6h
rows.Comments:
Avoid FQNs
Oseltamivir only if clinical suspicion of H1N1

rows.Common Pathogens: S. pyogens, S. aureus (MRSA) Polymicrobial (anaerobes + enterobacteriaceae)
rows.Empirical AMA: Piperacillin tazobactam 4.5g IV q6h + Vancomycin 15-20mg/kg IV q8-12h + Clindamycin 600-900mg IV q8h
rows.Alternate AMA: Meropenem 2g IV q8h + Vancomycin 15-20mg/kg IV q8-12h + Clindamycin 600-900mg IV q8h
rows.Comments:
Urgent debridement advised
Clindamycin/linezolid/tigecycline recommended for antitoxin effect in GAS/ staph infections

rows.Common Pathogens: E. coli, Enterococcus spp., Klebsiella spp., Proteus spp.
rows.Empirical AMA: Cefoperazone sulbactam(2:1) 3g IV q12h OR Ertapenem 1g q24h
rows.Alternate AMA: Meropenem 1g IV q8h OR Imipenem 500mg q6h
rows.Comments: Nitrofurantoin to be used only for uncomplicated cystitis

rows.Clinical Condition: Severe PN/ emphysematous PN/ perinephric abscess
rows.Common Pathogens: E. coli, klebsiella, pseudomonas, proteus, strep spp.
rows.Empirical AMA: Meropenem 1-2g IV q8h OR Imipenem 1gm q6-8h OR Doripenem 500mg q8h
rows.Alternate AMA: Colistin 9mU loading dose followed by 4.5mU q12h + carbapenem OR Fosfomycin 12-16g/day in 3 divided doses

rows.Common Pathogens: E. coli, Klebsiella spp., Proteus spp. Pseudomonas spp, Enterococcus spp, Candida spp
rows.Empirical AMA: Piperacillin tazobactam 4.5g IV 6-8h OR Meropenem 1-2g IV q8h OR Imipenem 1gm q6-8h OR Doripenem 500mg q8h
rows.Alternate AMA: Tigecycline 200mg loading dose followed by 100mg IV q12h +/- Polymyxin B IV 15 lac units LD followed by 5 lac units q8h
rows.Comments:
Surgical source control where possible
Fluconazole/echinocandin if risk of IA candidiasis
Anaerobic cover needed if ceftazidime avibactam used

rows.Common Pathogens: Staph aureus, CONS, Enterobacteriaceae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Candida spp
rows.Empirical AMA: Cefoperazone sulbactam(2:1) 3g IV q12h OR Piperacillin tazobactam 4.5g IV6-8h + Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV 12h OR Teicoplanin 12mg/kg q12h x 3 doses followed by 6mg/kg/d
rows.Alternate AMA: Meropenem 1-2g IV q8h OR Imipenem 1gm q6-8h OR Doripenem 500mg q8h +/- polymixin based on risk factors for CRE + Vancomycin/ teicoplanin
rows.Comments: Catheter removal especially for staph aureus, candida spp. ALT where appropriate for catheter salvage

rows.Common Pathogens: S. pneumonia, N. meningitides, H.influenzae, GBS, listeria monocytogenes
rows.Empirical AMA:
Ceftriaxone 2g IV q12h OR cefotaxime 2g IV q4-6h + Vancomycin 25-30mg/kg LD followed by 15mg/kg IV q8h +/- Ampicillin 2g IV q4h (if Age>60)
If any suggestion of encephalitis: to add acyclovir 10mg/kg tds for 2-3 weeks
rows.Comments: Dexamethasone 10mg IVq6h 15-20mins prior to/simultaneously with 1st dose of antibiotic-(to continue for 4 days if S. pneumonia established/ cultures negative)

rows.Empirical AMA: Meropenem 2g IV q8h + Vancomycin 25-30mg/kg LD followed by 15mg/kg IV q8h
rows.Alternate AMA:
CRE risk factors: add Polymyxin b/ colistin
MRSA Alternatives: Linezolid/ Daptomycin 10mg/kg/d
rows.Comments: Consider removal of shunts/ devices Intraventricular/ intrathecal antibiotics may be used (ID consult advised)
